name: Hyundai G.F. Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai G. F. Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of food services. It operates through the following business divisions: Corporate, Food Service, Heavy Equipment Manufacturing Sector, Furniture Manufacturing Sector, Building Materials, Bio Sector, Clothing Wholesale and Retail, and Others. The company was founded on February 27, 1968 and is headquartered in Gangnam-gu, South Korea.
